# Safety Cloud® support

How can we help you?

As the industry leader in digital alerting and connected safety, HAAS Alert is committed to keeping you safe on the road. If you need assistance with your Safety Cloud service, we're here to help. Simply fill out the support form, and a member of our team will be in touch.

Help, resources and FAQ's

[Knowledge base](https://support.haasalert.com/help)

Email support

[support@haasalert.com](mailto:support@haasalert.com?subject=Support%20Enquiry)

Call / text support

[(833) 433-4227](tel:8334334227) (HAAS)

Thanks for contacting us, we will respond to you shortly

Submit a support request

By providing your mobile number, you agree to receive SMS/MMS texts to service your support request. You may opt-out by replying STOP in the text reply

(Use XX - Name format where XX is the two-letter State/Region abbreviation)

Please choose the best option(s) that identifies the issue you're having.
